name: ButtonGroup
description: Fuses two actions into one control, a split button, with one hairline between them.

children.description: The fused actions: a Button and an IconButton menu trigger; at most two

aria-label.description: Names the group; required unless aria-labelledby is set

aria-labelledby.description: ID of the element that names the group

when: A split button: the main verb plus a menu of its variations
Two actions that read as one control
whenNot: Spacing separate buttons: use Stack (direction="row", gap, justify="end")
A form footer or verb cluster: use Stack
guidelines: At most two; a third verb goes in a Menu
The fused halves share one opaque hairline whatever their variant; outer corners keep the control radius
Give both halves the same size and variant family
Always name the group with aria-label or aria-labelledby
accessibility: Renders role="group"; a dev warning fires when it has no name
Name the menu trigger for what it opens ("More save options")

examples.name: Split Button
examples.description: The main verb, then a menu of its variations.
examples.code:
import { CaretDown } from '@phosphor-icons/react';
import { IconButton } from '@/components/IconButton';
import { Menu } from '@/components/Menu';

<ButtonGroup aria-label="Save options">
  <Button variant="soft">Save</Button>
  <Menu>
    <Menu.Trigger
      render={
        <IconButton variant="soft" aria-label="More save options">
          <CaretDown />
        </IconButton>
      }
    />
    <Menu.Content>
      <Menu.Item>Save as draft</Menu.Item>
      <Menu.Item>Save and close</Menu.Item>
    </Menu.Content>
  </Menu>
</ButtonGroup>

examples.name: Verb Cluster
examples.description: Separate buttons are a Stack, right-aligned, at most two.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="row" gap="sm" justify="end">
  <Button variant="soft">Cancel</Button>
  <Button>Save</Button>
</Stack>

relations.note: The main verb of a split button
The menu trigger half of a split button
Stack spaces separate buttons; ButtonGroup only fuses

propsSummary: children: ReactNode - at most two fused actions
aria-label or aria-labelledby - required group name
